name: Alexa+
summary: Amazon's generative Alexa, with remembered personal details, routines and agentic web tasks across Echo devices, the Alexa app and the web.

sources.title: Amazon introduces the next generation of Alexa
Alexa+ is available free for Prime members
Request your personal information from Amazon

claims.value: Reaches Amazon's own services, including Ring footage and AI video search, Prime Video, Amazon Music and Photos, alongside shopping and smart home
Navigates the internet in a self-directed way to complete tasks behind the scenes; no control of the user's own device is described
Navigates the web on the user's behalf from Amazon's side
Voice is the primary interface, across Echo devices, Echo Show, Fire TV and the Alexa app
Routines, reminders and calendar management, with agentic tasks completed behind the scenes; a user-facing scheduler for autonomous runs is not described
No native desktop app; the web experience is at Alexa.com
Alexa apps for iPhone and Android
Echo devices, Echo Show, Echo Hub, Fire TV, the Alexa app and Alexa.com
Amazon Nova and Anthropic models run in Amazon's cloud
Fully managed; personal model keys are not described
Included with Prime at no extra cost; otherwise a standalone subscription
US$19.99 a month, free for Prime members across the whole household; non-Prime customers can also use a limited free text chat on Alexa.com and in the app
Amazon's cloud, reached through Echo devices, the app and the web
No public API for Alexa+ as a personal agent is described
Remember This stores details on request; remembered items are reviewable under Alexa Privacy, and Amazon notes they may be accessible to anyone using the household's devices
Amazon's general personal-information request covers account data; a dedicated export of remembered items is not described
Voice recordings, transcripts and typed requests can be reviewed and deleted in Alexa Privacy settings
Generally available in the United States and Canada, with early access in Brazil, the United Kingdom, Mexico, Italy, Spain, Germany, Austria and France
claims.shortValue: US and Canada; early access elsewhere

platforms.detail: Alexa.com, plus a limited free text chat for customers without Prime.

access.detail: Generally available in the United States and Canada; early access in eight further countries, with more to come.

onYourComputer.detail: Nothing runs on the user's computer; Alexa+ acts from Amazon's side and on Echo hardware.

agentComputer.detail: Runs in Amazon's cloud. No remote view of a machine of its own is offered.

whileYouAreOff.detail: Runs on Amazon's cloud and Echo hardware rather than the user's computer, so tasks do not depend on a personal device being on.

worksWithoutVendor.detail: Provider-hosted and tied to Amazon's services and devices. The company has not published what happens if it is discontinued.

dataAfterExit.detail: Amazon's general request-your-personal-information flow returns account data by download link; no self-serve export of remembered items is described.

plans.name: Included with Prime
includes: Full Alexa+ across every Alexa-enabled device, Alexa.com and the app

plans.name: Alexa+
includes: Full Alexa+ experience across devices, web and the app
limits: A limited free text chat is available without paying

cost.note: included with a Prime membership; a limited free text chat needs no subscription

hardware.name: Echo devices
hardware.detail: Runs on Echo speakers, Echo Show, Echo Hub and Fire TV, and is also reachable from the Alexa app and Alexa.com without buying hardware.

launches.label: Announced at Amazon's Devices and Services event
General availability in the US and Canada, free for Prime

newsSource.note: No dedicated changelog; updates appear as dated newsroom posts
